title: Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards Tier Qualification Schedule
content:
Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards places every member business in one of six tiers, ranked from ProBuild Member to ProBuild Platinum Elite, according to the qualifying spend it accumulates in the program year. The program year is the calendar year.

## Entry thresholds

| Rank | Tier | Annual qualifying spend at which the tier is reached | Customer profile | Business verification |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | ProBuild Member | USD 0.00 | pro | required |
| 2 | ProBuild Bronze | USD 5000.00 | pro | required |
| 3 | ProBuild Silver | USD 10000.00 | pro | required |
| 4 | ProBuild Gold | USD 25000.00 | pro | required |
| 5 | ProBuild Platinum | USD 75000.00 | pro | required |
| 6 | ProBuild Platinum Elite | USD 150000.00 | pro | required |

Every tier is open only to a business on a pro customer profile whose business has been verified.

## Program year and tier movement

| Tier | Qualification period (program year) | Months a tier earned in a program year is kept after that year ends | Most tiers dropped at one annual evaluation | Moves up as soon as year-to-date qualifying spend reaches a higher tier's threshold |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ProBuild Member | 12 months | 12 months | 1 | Yes |
| ProBuild Bronze | 12 months | 12 months | 1 | Yes |
| ProBuild Silver | 12 months | 12 months | 1 | Yes |
| ProBuild Gold | 12 months | 12 months | 1 | Yes |
| ProBuild Platinum | 12 months | 12 months | 1 | Yes |
| ProBuild Platinum Elite | 12 months | 12 months | 1 | Yes |

The four columns above carry the same figure at every tier: a 12-month qualification period, a 12-month hold after the year ends, a drop of no more than 1 tier at an annual evaluation, and upgrade during the year.

## Reading the thresholds (hypothetical figures)

A threshold is reached when qualifying spend comes to the threshold figure or more.

| Hypothetical qualifying spend | Highest tier whose threshold it reaches |
|---|---|
| USD 4999.99 | ProBuild Member |
| USD 5000.00 | ProBuild Bronze |
| USD 24999.99 | ProBuild Silver |
| USD 25000.00 | ProBuild Gold |
| USD 149999.99 | ProBuild Platinum |
| USD 150000.00 | ProBuild Platinum Elite |
